lines.trans: Sandrine, did you read this great script?
I do not want sad dramas anymore.
Daniele Thompson offers a magnificent role!
I prefer to make the audience laugh.
You want to go on stage alone?
Comedy gives me crazy energy.
But it is a very difficult trade.
Precisely, this new project pleases me a lot.
And the shoot of the historical film?
Tell them that I am unavailable.
The producers expect your prompt reply though.
I already landed an opening act!
Are you really going to perform five minutes?
Yes, get ready for my show!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Monsieur Audibert nous reçoit dans cinq minutes.
examples.trans: Mr Audibert will see us in five minutes.

meanings.en: to give a hand (donner un coup de main)
faire un drame = to make a big fuss

meanings.note: décrocher une audition = to land an audition

examples.text: Elle avait déjà pris sa décision.
examples.trans: She had already made her decision.

pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle
un drame historique = a historical drama

meanings.note: jouer un rôle, jouer le frère de...
jouer au foot, jouer du piano
